evaluator: Holdout A — PR-015, Prof. Margaret Morse lens
evidence: The About page explicitly names the lineage as “artistic, civic, technical, and social” and connects Open House, WOWList, Sunday Dinner/196, NYC Artist Coalition work, and Source-Backed Team Memory through direct links.

More than three project continuities are visible: Open House frames collective experimentation and inhabited space; WOWList connects community vocabulary and participation to a technical platform; Sunday Dinner/196 frames hospitality, artist support, trust, and continuity as infrastructure; FairRentNYC treats civic participation and documentation as infrastructure; Source-Backed Team Memory extends care and documentation into human-reviewed technical practice.

The recurring operating method is stated clearly: observe relationships, model a system, prototype an interface, test it with people, and document enough for others to continue. The homepage restates this as clarify, structure, build, document, and transfer.

Job fit remains prominent through explicit positioning for technical project management, product operations, implementation, business analysis, civic/govtech delivery, documentation architecture, stakeholder coordination, and durable handoffs.

Project pages translate the conceptual lineage into practical outputs such as event workflows, resident guidance, onboarding, facilitation, source maps, decision records, campaign websites, action tracking, and public communication.

Collective credit is maintained through wording such as “co-built,” “with many collaborators,” and explicit statements that campaign and policy accomplishments are collective and not solely caused by Jamie.

Privacy and protected-source boundaries are repeatedly visible: guest lists, contact details, private correspondence, attendance histories, legal-review context, stakeholder information, raw strategy materials, private transcripts, and unapproved collaborator context remain excluded.

The lab clearly distinguishes known, open, and protected material; identifies its example as synthetic; preserves disagreement for review; and disclaims production SaaS, surveillance, private-archive browsing, and replacement of human judgment.
CallNYC visibly identifies itself as independent, unofficial, archived, and unsuitable for current constituent-service guidance, preventing civic authority or currency from being overstated.
safety_findings: No visible breach of collective-credit, privacy, consent, or protected-source boundaries was found in the scoped copy and links.
Sensitive work is consistently summarized at an aggregate or public-safe level, with explicit exclusions and scope limitations.
recommendation: Pass PR-015 as written; the scoped surfaces visibly establish the interdisciplinary continuity, operating method, job relevance, and ethical boundaries required for a score of 4.
